description: This file implements a web page for the first step of a home network wizard. It includes HTML, PHP embedment, JavaScript, and form validation logic to allow users to change their router's admin password, with client-side validation and dynamic UI updates.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines the instance number based on the logged-in user.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the new password configuration to the server and handles response.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates password inputs and initiates configuration update.
